registry-build.description: Build Ndop's registry with ndop build: validate, type-check, snapshot and write static JSON.

registry-e2e.description: Install-test the registry: publish @ndop/* to Verdaccio, then ng new, ndop init, ndop add and ng build per package manager (ADR-0015).

serve-site.description: Serve a built static site the way Cloudflare Pages does, for end-to-end tests.

docs-lighthouse.description: Run Lighthouse on every route of the built docs site and fail under the minimum score (ADR-0016).

agent-eval.description: Run the agent eval suite: headless Claude Code with only the Ndop MCP server builds each prompt in a fixture app, scored by ndop verify (ADR-0019).

update-e2e.description: Run the update fixture suite: ndop add an old version, apply local edits, ndop update, and check files, statuses, exit codes and the lockfile (ADR-0020).
